subject: DI03000101

body.en:
Understand the idea

A practical network balances reliable service,acceptable voltage,safety,power quality and economic operation.

Explanation and application

  • Desirable features:continuity,redundancy where justified,acceptable voltage/frequency,adequate capacity,low losses and maintainable equipment.
  • Protection must detect/isolate faults selectively;earthing and touch/step-voltage controls protect people while metering and switching support operation.
  • Allow load growth,renewable backfeed and service restoration;an idealised zero-drop system is not a claim that real networks have zero impedance.
Distributor versus feeder?

Distributor has tapping-point voltage constraints;feeder primarily carries bulk current but also needs other checks.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Practical network reliability,યોગ્ય V,safety,power quality/economy balance કરે છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Continuity,યોગ્ય redundancy,V-frequency,capacity,low losses/maintainability જોઈએ.
  • Selective protection faults isolate કરે.Earthing/touch-step controls લોકોનું રક્ષણ કરે.Metering/switching operationમાં મદદ કરે.
  • Growth,renewable backfeed/restoration allowance લો.Ideal zero-drop એટલે actual zero impedance નથી.
Distributor/Feeder ફરક?

Distributor tap V constraints ધરાવે;feeder bulk I સાથે other checks પણ માંગે.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Classify each section by its network role,not by conductor appearance.

Explanation and application

  • A feeder carries bulk current from a substation toward an area/transformer network;classic teaching models take no consumer tapping along it.Capacity/thermal duty is a major design concern.
  • A distributor has load tapping points along its length;section currents change with downstream load,so terminal voltage drop is a key design criterion.Real utilities may use overlapping terminology.
  • Service mains connect the distributor to a consumer service point with required isolation,protection and metering;they are not an informal unprotected branch.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Conductorના દેખાવથી નહિ,network roleથી section ઓળખો.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Feeder substationથી area-transformer network તરફ bulk I લઈ જાય.Classic modelમાં consumer taps નથી.Capacity/thermal duty મહત્વનું છે.
  • Distributor પર load taps હોય.Downstream load પ્રમાણે section I બદલાય;Vdrop મહત્વનું છે.Actual utility terminology overlap થઈ શકે.
  • Service mains distributorને consumer point સાથે isolation,protection/meteringથી જોડે;unprotected informal branch નથી.

body.en:
Understand the idea

State AC/DC,voltage tier,wire/phase arrangement,installation and connection scheme separately.

Explanation and application

  • Primary/secondary distribution describe voltage/function;overhead/underground describe installation;radial/ring/interconnected describe topology.
  • ACarrangements include single-phase two-wire and three-phase three/four-wire systems according to service duty;neutral and protective earth are not freely interchangeable.
  • Balanced fundamental phase currents can sum to zero,but unbalance and triplen harmonics can load the neutral;do not size or disconnect it from an assumed zero alone.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

AC/DC,Vtier,phase-wire arrangement,installation/connection scheme અલગ લખો.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Primary-secondary function/Vtier છે.OH-UG installation અને radial-ring-interconnected topology છે.
  • Service પ્રમાણે single-phase two-wire/three-phase three-four-wire હોય.Neutral/protective earth મનસ્વી interchangeable નથી.
  • Balanced fundamental I sum zero હોઈ શકે;unbalance/triplen harmonics neutralમાં I આપે.Assumed zeroથી size/disconnection નનક્કી કરો.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Primary feeds local transformers;secondary supplies end-user voltage through local distributors/services.

Explanation and application

  • Examples of primary levels include11/22/33kVdepending on utility;distribution transformers step down to the specified LVsystem,commonly described as230/400Vor local240/415Vconventions.
  • Transformer rating,impedance,earthing,load balance and protective coordination govern LVperformance;the transformer does not guarantee identical voltage at distant consumers.
  • Use actual utility voltage and line/phase conventions in a calculation;do not combine11kVline-line with a phase current using a single-phase power formula.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Primary local transformerને અને secondary local distributor-serviceથી userને supply કરે છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Utility પ્રમાણે11/22/33kV primary examples છે.Transformer specified LVમાં ઉતારે;230/400Vકે local240/415V convention ચકાસો.
  • Transformer rating,Z,earthing,load balance/protection LVperformance નક્કી કરે.Distant consumersએ same Vની guarantee નથી.
  • Actual utility V/line-phase convention લો.11kVline-line/phase Iને single-phase formulaમાં mix નકરો.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Classify by available source paths and actual normal switching state.

Explanation and application

  • Radial has one normal supply path:simple protection and lower cost,but an upstream fault can interrupt downstream loads.
  • Ring main provides alternative paths around a loop.It may operate normally open or closed by design;section isolation/restoration needs authorised switching and backfeed control.
  • Interconnected networks tie multiple feeders/substations to improve flexibility/reliability,but fault duty,load sharing and protection are more complex.No student tie-closing operation is implied.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Available source paths/normal switching stateથી classify કરો.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Radialમાં એક normal path છે.Protection સરળ/cost ઓછો,પણ upstream fault downstreamને interrupt કરે.
  • Ringમાં alternate paths હોય.Design મુજબ normally open-closed હોઈ શકે.Isolation-restorationમાં authorised switching/backfeed control જોઈએ.
  • Interconnected feeders-substationsથી flexibility/reliability સુધરે;fault duty,sharing/protection complex બને.Student tie-closing permission નથી.

body.en:
Understand the idea

A loop on a drawing does not prove every switch is normally closed.

Explanation and application

  • Identify the source,section switches,normal open point,protection zones and loads before describing a restoration route.
  • Isolate the faulted section with approved dead/energised-switching procedures by authorised operators;confirm isolation,ratings and healthy alternative capacity.
  • Backfeed can energise a supposedly dead section;field work requires formal isolation,verification,earthing and permits,not merely moving the normal open point.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Drawingમાં loop એટલે દરેક switch normally closed છે એવું નથી.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Restoration સમજાવતાં પહેલાં source,section switches,normal open point,zones/loads ઓળખો.
  • Authorised operator approved procedureથી fault section isolate કરે.Isolation,ratings/alternate capacity verify કરે.
  • Backfeedથી supposed-dead section live થઈ શકે.Field workમાં formal isolation,verify,earthing/permit જોઈએ;ફક્ત open point ખસેડવું પૂરતું નથી.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Multiple sources/feeders provide alternative network paths subject to coordinated protection and operating rules.

Explanation and application

  • Load sharing follows source/network impedances and controls;alternative paths do not guarantee full capacity after every outage.
  • Interconnection changes fault level,relay coordination and backfeed exposure;operators verify source compatibility,ratings and approved switching plans.
  • The drawing is a single-line topology,not permission to parallel sources or close a utility tie.No student live switching is authorised.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Multiple source-feeders coordinated protection/rules સાથે alternate paths આપે છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Sharing source-network Z/controls પ્રમાણે થાય.Alternate path એટલે દરેક outage પછી full capacityની guarantee નથી.
  • Interconnection fault level,relay coordination/backfeed બદલે.Operator compatibility,ratings/approved plans verify કરે.
  • Drawing single-line topology છે.Source parallel/utility tie close permission નથી.Student live switching authorised નથી.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Check every relevant constraint;do not select cable/conductor area from one voltage-drop equation alone.

Explanation and application

  • Feeder:maximum demand,diversity,growth,ampacity,thermal environment,short-circuit withstand and protection coordination;long feeders also require voltage-drop checks.
  • Distributor:downstream current sums,tap voltages,pf,unbalance,neutral loading,loss and permissible customer voltage range.
  • Installation derating,soil/duct grouping,joints,clearance,mechanical strength,reliability and lifecycle cost can set a larger size than the unconstrained economic area.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

દરેક relevant constraint ચકાસો.ફક્ત Vdrop equationથી area નપસંદ કરો.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Feederમાં demand,diversity,growth,ampacity,environment,SC/protection જોઈએ.Long feederમાં Vdrop પણ ચકાસો.
  • Distributorમાં downstream I,tap V,pf,unbalance,neutral,loss/customer voltage range લો.
  • Installation derating,soil-duct grouping,joints,clearance,strength,reliability/costથી economic area કરતાં મોટો size જોઈએ શકે.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

Balanced three-phase line;R/Xare per-phase section values;current lags the receiving voltage by φ;small-drop approximation only.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Write Ir=I(cosφ−j sinφ),Z=R+jX.
  2. ZIr=I(Rcosφ+Xsinφ)+jI(Xcosφ−Rsinφ).
  3. The approximate in-phase phase drop is I(Rcosφ+Xsinφ);balanced line-line drop is √3times this.
  4. For multiple taps,sum each section drop using its own downstream phasor current.Leading pfchanges the reactive sign;exact work uses Vs=Vr+ΣZjIj.

Interpretation and check

For a single-phase two-wire circuit use complete loop impedance:if zgiven is per conductor,multiply by two only once.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

Balanced three-phase,per-phase R-X અને lagging φ લો.Small-drop approximation છે.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. Ir=I(cosφ−j sinφ)/Z=R+jX લખો.
  2. Multiply કરતાં ZIr=I(Rcosφ+Xsinφ)+jI(Xcosφ−Rsinφ) છે.
  3. Approximate phase drop I(Rcosφ+Xsinφ) છે.Balanced line-line drop √3ગણો છે.
  4. Multiple tapsમાં દરેક sectionના downstream phasorથી drop sum કરો.Leadingમાં reactive sign બદલાય.Exact Vs=Vr+ΣZjIj લો.

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

Single-phase two-wireમાં complete loop Z લો.Per-conductor z હોય તો જ એકવાર બેગણું કરો.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

Uniform current demand iA/m along a one-ended length L;all currents have the same reference/pf;per-length loop or phase impedance zmatches the stated circuit.

Step-by-step solution

  1. At distance xfrom source,the section carries downstream current I(x)=i(L−x).
  2. An element dxhas impedance zdxand contributes dV=z i(L−x)dx.
  3. Integrate from0to L:ΔV=z iL²/2=zL Itotal/2,where Itotal=iL.
  4. The voltage drop equals that of the total current concentrated at the midpoint under these assumptions,not all at the far end.

Interpretation and check

This is a fixed-current linear model.Constant-power loads need voltage-dependent currents/iteration;loss equivalence is not the same as midpoint voltage-drop equivalence.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

Length L પર uniform iA/m/same reference-pf લો.Per-length loop/phase z circuit સાથે મેળ ખાતું હોવું જોઈએ.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. Sourceથી xએ section current I(x)=i(L−x) છે.
  2. Element dxનું Z=zdx હોવાથી dV=z i(L−x)dx છે.
  3. 0થી L integrate કરતાં ΔV=z iL²/2=zL Itotal/2 છે,Itotal=iL લો.
  4. આ assumptionsમાં total current midpointએ concentrated હોય તેટલો drop મળે;far end પર બધો load ગણવો ખોટું છે.

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

આ fixed-current linear model છે.Constant-powerમાં currents/iteration જોઈએ.Midpoint Vdrop equivalence એટલે loss equivalence નથી.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

Balanced line,per-phase R=0.2Ω,X=0.1Ω,current50Aat0.8lagging;use approximate voltage drop.

Step-by-step solution

  1. sinφ=0.6;phase drop=50(0.2×0.8+0.1×0.6)=11V.
  2. Line-line drop≈√3×11=19.0526V;from400Vreceiving reference,this is about4.7631%of that base.
  3. If receiving VLLis400V,approximate sending VLL≈419.0526V.This is not an exact phasor-magnitude calculation.

Interpretation and check

State whether400Vis receiving or sending voltage before reporting percentage;no legal voltage-limit claim follows.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

Balanced lineમાં per-phase R=0.2Ω,X=0.1Ω,I50A/0.8lagging લો.Approximate Vdrop છે.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. sinφ=0.6 અને phase drop=50(0.2×0.8+0.1×0.6)=11V છે.
  2. Line-line drop≈√3×11=19.0526V છે.400Vreceiving baseએ લગભગ4.7631% છે.
  3. Receiving VLL400V હોય તો approximate sending419.0526V છે.આ exact phasor magnitude નથી.

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

400V sending કે receiving છે તે લખો.અહીંથી legal voltage-limit claim નથી.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

Per-phase reference at far end Vr=230+j0V;fixed load currents I1=20−j15A,I2=10−j5A;each section z=0.1+j0.08Ω.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Far section carries I2;near section carries I1+I2=30−j20A.
  2. Far drop=zI2=1.4+j0.3V;middle voltage=231.4+j0.3V.
  3. Near drop=z(I1+I2)=4.6+j0.4V;Vs=236+j0.7V.
  4. |Vs|≈236.0010V.The given currents use one common reference,not independently assigned local pfangles.

Interpretation and check

Do not add current magnitudes20/10etc instead of phasors;for constant-power taps solve currents at their actual local voltages.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

Far-end Vr=230+j0V/referenceમાં fixed I1=20−j15A,I2=10−j5A લો.દરેક z=0.1+j0.08Ω છે.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. Far section I2/near section I1+I2=30−j20A વહન કરે.
  2. Far drop=zI2=1.4+j0.3V/middle V231.4+j0.3V છે.
  3. Near drop=z(I1+I2)=4.6+j0.4V/Vs236+j0.7V છે.
  4. |Vs|≈236.0010V છે.Currents common referenceમાં છે;independent local pfangles નથી.

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

Phasorsના બદલે20/10 જેવી magnitudes sum નકરો.Constant-power tapsમાં actual local V પરથી currents solve કરો.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

Uniform load totals40Aover200m;per-conductor resistance0.001Ω/m;unity pf,neglect X;two-wire loop.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Loop resistance per metre=2×0.001=0.002Ω/m.
  2. Uniform-load drop=Itotal rloop L/2=40×0.002×200/2=8V.
  3. If all40Awere concentrated at the far end,the same loop gives16Vdrop.The uniform load has half that drop,not zero.

Interpretation and check

The factor two for return path and factor one-half for uniform distribution have different origins.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

200m પર uniform total40A,per-conductor R0.001Ω/m,unity pf/X ignore અને two-wire loop લો.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. Loop R per metre=2×0.001=0.002Ω/m છે.
  2. Uniform drop=Itotal rloop L/2=40×0.002×200/2=8V છે.
  3. બધો40A far endએ હોય તો16Vdrop છે.Uniformમાં તેનો અડધો મળે,zero નહીં.

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

Return-pathનો બે factor/uniform-loadનો અડધો factor અલગ કારણોથી આવે છે.

body.en:
Definition

An insulated cable carries power through a controlled conductor-dielectric-sheath structure suited to its installation.

Classification / representative type

  • First classify voltage,core count,insulation,screen/armour and installation duty;the picture is a representative single-core layered view,not every cable.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Copper/aluminium conductor,stranded where required,carries load current with suitable joints and cross-section.
  2. Insulation such as PVCor XLPEwith specified thickness withstands electrical stress;HVdesigns include controlled semiconducting conductor/insulation screens.
  3. Metallic screen/sheath provides the designed field boundary,fault-current path and/or moisture barrier;its function and bonding must be specified.
  4. Bedding/separation layers protect inner components and support armour when fitted.
  5. Armour provides specified mechanical protection;ACsingle-core designs require care with magnetic armour/sheath losses.
  6. Outer sheath protects against moisture,abrasion and environmental attack;identification and end sealing preserve intended service.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Load current flows in the conductor and creates heat through resistance.
  2. The dielectric separates live conductor from other cores/earth and withstands normal/surge stress.
  3. Screens distribute electric stress and sheath/bonding arrangements manage fault/induced-current duties according to design.
  4. Heat passes through insulation,sheath and surrounding soil/ducts;thermal conditions limit ampacity.
  5. Terminations/joints continue insulation,screen and mechanical protection without unacceptable stress concentration.
  6. Protection clears faults;inspection/testing and correct installation preserve reliability.Underground placement does not make a damaged cable safe.

Limitations and safety

Only authorised isolated cable work;no live cutting,DIYHVjointing or improvised sheath-bonding/earth connections.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Conductor-dielectric-sheath structureવાળો cable installation પ્રમાણે power વહન કરે છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / દર્શાવેલો પ્રકાર

  • પહેલાં V,core count,insulation,screen-armour/install dutyથી classify કરો.Picture representative single-core છે;દરેક cable આવો નથી.

Construction — ભાગ તથા કામ

  1. Copper-aluminium conductor/strands યોગ્ય joint-area સાથે I વહન કરે.
  2. PVC-XLPE insulation stress સહે.HVમાં controlled semiconducting screens હોય.
  3. Metallic screen-sheath field boundary,fault path/moisture barrierનું specified કામ કરે.Bonding specify કરવું જોઈએ.
  4. Bedding-separation inner layers protect/armour support કરે.
  5. Armour specified mechanical protection આપે.ACsingle-coreમાં magnetic armour/sheath lossનું ધ્યાન લો.
  6. Outer sheath moisture-abrasion/environment સામે રક્ષણ આપે.Identity/end seal service જાળવે.

Working — ક્રમ તથા કારણ

  1. Conductorમાં Iથી resistive heat બને.
  2. Dielectric cores-earthથી અલગ રાખી normal-surge stress સહે.
  3. Screens stress distribute કરે;sheath-bonding fault/induced-current duties manage કરે.
  4. Heat layersથી soil-ductમાં જાય.Thermal conditions ampacity મર્યાદિત કરે.
  5. Joint-termination insulation-screen/protection continuity રાખી stress concentration ટાળે.
  6. Protection faults clear કરે.Correct installation/tests reliability રાખે.Damaged underground cable safe નથી.

મર્યાદા તથા સલામતી

Authorised isolated work જ કરો.Live cutting,DIYHVjoint/bonding improvisation નકરો.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Do not identify voltage capability from colour,diameter or armour alone.

Explanation and application

  • By insulation:PVC,XLPEand legacy impregnated-paper systems;by cores:single/two/three/four/multicore;by protection:armoured/unarmoured,screened/unscreened as specified.
  • By construction/voltage duty:LVcables,screened MV/HVcables and specialised pressure/oil/gas-filled legacy systems.Textbook LT/HT/ST/EHTboundaries vary;actual standard/rated U0/U/Umgoverns.
  • Belted paper and screened H/SLtypes are historical construction categories,not mandatory layers of every XLPEcable.Select by voltage,ampacity,installation,fire/environment duty and approved standard.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

ફક્ત colour,diameter/armour પરથી voltage capability નઓળખો.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Insulationથી PVC,XLPE/legacy paper;coresથી single-two-three-four-multicore;protectionથી armoured-unarmoured/screened-unscreened છે.
  • Construction-dutyમાં LV,screened MV-HV/pressure-oil-gas legacy systems આવે.Textbook LT-HT-ST-EHT boundaries બદલાય;actual U0/U/Um rating મુખ્ય છે.
  • Belted paper/H-SL screened historical categories છે;દરેક XLPEના layers નથી.V,ampacity,installation,fire-environment/standardથી પસંદ કરો.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Installation must preserve electrical,thermal and mechanical design throughout the route and joints.

Explanation and application

  • Laying methods include direct buried trenches,ducts,troughs/tunnels and supported trays as suited to duty;survey utilities,drainage,thermal soil and future access before selection.
  • Control pulling tension,bend radius,rollers,sidewall pressure,depth/separation and markers using actual standards/manufacturer values;do not invent one universal burial depth.
  • Joint families include straight-through,branch and termination systems.Qualified jointing maintains conductor contact,insulation stress control,screen/sheath continuity,moisture sealing and mechanical support.
  • Isolation,dead verification,earthing/discharge,approved kits/cleanliness,tests and as-built records are essential.Partial discharge and incorrect screen cuts can cause delayed failure.
